# Vendor-shaped proxy list: one long username shared across the whole pool,
# which is how Webshare, Bright Data, Oxylabs et al. actually ship lists.
#
# Masked, every line here renders as the same
# "http://vendorpool-static-residential-rotating:****@..." prefix, so a table that
# prints the masked URL truncates all three rows to an identical string and
# stops saying which proxy was slow. The distinguishing part is host:port.
#
# Loopback ports 1-3 never listen, so these ECONNREFUSE immediately: no
# network access and no timeout wait.
http://vendorpool-static-residential-rotating:s3cretpassword@127.0.0.1:1
http://vendorpool-static-residential-rotating:s3cretpassword@127.0.0.1:2
http://vendorpool-static-residential-rotating:s3cretpassword@127.0.0.1:3
